pageSummary: Sixteen named Arkansans in Kelly's big tent — who she is talking to when she speaks. Use the badge on every practice line: picture one person, not a crowd.
modelNote: Fictional personas for message targeting only — not voter file rows. Location overlays combine region, city intelligence tags, and aggregate SOS registration mix.

profiles.tagline: Voted before, drifted — needs competence, not slogans
profiles.demographicSketch: Late 50s · suburban Little Rock · college-educated · voted in 2020, sat out 2022
profiles.geographySketch: Pulaski, Saline, Faulkner suburbs; Central Metro cluster
profiles.estimatedShareNote: Planning est. 8–12% of statewide persuadable pool in Tier A counties
whatTheyNeedToHear: Kelly has run things — SOS is operations, not performance
Clerks will get clear rules and respect
Democratic recovery is practical access, not Twitter fights
profiles.kellyTone: Warm executive — short sentences, zero condescension
doNotSay: You must turn out or democracy dies
